data.desc: For more than 35 years, Garmin has developed innovative technology for the fitness, outdoor, aviation, marine and automotive OEM markets. Engineered on the inside for life on the outside, Garmin products are purpose built to help people make the most of the time they spend pursuing their passions. Garmin is committed to building products known for quality, reliability, and durability across its global portfolio of connected devices and services. Garmin Ltd. (NYSE: GRMN) is incorporated in Switzerland, and its principal subsidiaries are located in the United States, Taiwan and the United Kingdom.
